ideas.pitch: A mobile UI/UX design system specifically tailored for neurodivergent and visually impaired commuters navigating Mumbai's local trains and metro.
ideas.problem_statement: Drishti UI/UX Design Hackathon - User-focused problem-solving and inclusive design application
ideas.title: AccessibleTransit Mumbai
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on high-empathy inclusive UI/UX design, which directly addresses the core evaluation criteria of design thinking and user-focused problem-solving at Drishti.

ideas.pitch: A gamified financial literacy mobile app interface designed for gig workers in urban India to seamlessly manage micro-investments.
ideas.problem_statement: Drishti UI/UX Design Hackathon - User-focused problem-solving and creative interface design
ideas.title: FinLit Flow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a highly relevant real-world socio-economic problem in India with an intuitive, clean component library and high-fidelity prototype that looks polished in a short window.

ideas.pitch: An interactive citizen-science UI companion for tracking urban waste segregation and composting schedules via image-based verification flows.
ideas.problem_statement: Drishti UI/UX Design Hackathon - Creativity, design thinking, and UX/UI skills
ideas.title: EcoSnap UI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages gamification and behavioral psychology patterns in UX to drive community engagement, an approach that typically resonates well with design panels.

ideas.pitch: A multilingual healthcare appointment and symptom-checker UI designed specifically for semi-literate rural patients visiting urban hospitals.
ideas.problem_statement: Drishti UI/UX Design Hackathon - Overall design potential and user-focused problem-solving
ideas.title: MedAssist Dialect
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses accessibility through voice-first interface design paradigms and icon-heavy navigation, showcasing advanced UX research thinking.

ideas.pitch: An all-in-one student project workspace dashboard focused on asynchronous collaboration and rapid prototype feedback loops for design teams.
ideas.problem_statement: Drishti UI/UX Design Hackathon - Teamwork, collaboration, and working prototype creation
